objects.text: Competitive analysis in marketing and strategic management is an assessment of the strengths and weaknesses of current and potential competitors. Profiling combines all of the relevant sources of competitor analysis into one framework in the support of efficient and effective strategy formulation, implementation, monitoring and adjustment.
